md4_sentence_at_issue: Both instruments agree that partially reprogrammed cells read younger. Their claim is supported and our earlier negatives reflected the wrong test (a within-state trajectory with no baseline).
what_would_settle: An independent fibroblast age instrument scored on these same Louvain-labelled PartialReprog vs Fibroblast cells at the same donor × timepoint, or the authors' Seurat v5 / sctransform v2 object with the frozen ruler projected onto that split.
contrast_function: md4_task1._one_contrast for scheme (a); stratified variant for scheme (b)
